scope: Shared strict Cron recurrence and its current Schedule record consumers

paired.method: Actual fixed util/time Cron and Schedule domain versus Native, exact fields, canonical text, rejections, error causes/names/codes/messages and latest/next decisions.

verification.source: 147 original util/time and Schedule Cron tests passed.
verification.native: 17 passed: shared Cron and direct Schedule consumers, previously added wall/interval/time contracts and historical regressions.

behavior: Five strict numeric fields support stars, lists, ranges and range/star steps. Canonicalization preserves Vixie star flags and Sunday folding independently of matched values.
Bounded forward/backward calendar walks retain a 400-year horizon, skip unselected months, preserve a committed due floor and stop at four-digit instant exhaustion.

Source-paired decisions include repeated DST hours, forward gaps, skipped dates, opposite-side UTC/local dates, leap-day rules, year-zero local floor and year-10000 local ceiling. Immutable matched fields and exact Schedule record decoding keep reads independent of target recomputation.

cleanup.retained: Paired fields/errors/decisions and hashes, commands, Source results and Native logs/XML/observations; owned synthetic workspaces and homes removed.

limitations: RRULE, Host storage, management, runtime and tools remain pending; staged rule modules do not promote production bindings.
No full regression, application/session, Portable/browser/Win7 qualification or upstream promotion.
